question: Should this draft remain open as source material while the Claws stack is rewritten to the current RFC, or should maintainers request a fresh diagnostics PR after the base contract is approved?
rationale: The mechanical state-read defect is clear, but the RFC explicitly supersedes the branch's product model and the protected maintainer label requires a human decision about preserving and restacking this branch.

options.title: Keep as restack source
options.body: Keep the draft open, repair the read-only boundary, and rewrite it in stack order against the grouped one-new-agent contract.

options.title: Request a fresh PR later
options.body: Pause or close this branch after maintainer review and invite a new diagnostics PR once the prerequisite contract is approved.

recommendation.title: Keep as restack source
recommendation.body: Keep the draft open, repair the read-only boundary, and rewrite it in stack order against the grouped one-new-agent contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The RFC identifies Patrick's requested product-model and schema boundaries, making him the strongest available owner for deciding whether this prototype branch should be preserved during restacking.
